name: GSGEN Appearance Refinement
definition: Iterative optimization stage to improve fine-grained details using 2D image prior and compactness-based densification, while preserving geometry.
summary: GSGEN Appearance Refinement is an iterative optimization stage that enhances visual details in text-to-3D generation using compactness-based densification and 3D Stable Diffusion Score Distillation Sampling to preserve structural integrity.
